messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-09-19] standup/boreal/2025-09-19: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from the reporting service.
- [2025-11-13] standup/boreal/2025-11-13: The reporting service still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-02-13] standup/boreal/2025-02-13: The notifier calls the event-bus for delivery events, so treat the event-bus as a hard dependency of the notifier. Dependency map update: webhooks needs the event-bus (outbound events).
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2025-04-22] standup/boreal/2025-04-22: Per the change policy, the event-bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-05-05] standup/boreal/2026-05-05: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.
- [2025-11-11] standup/boreal/2025-11-11-2: Heads-up from team Boreal: the event bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2: Reminder: the event-bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-02-06] standup/dune/2025-02-06: If the ledger service is down, the reports pipeline is down: it relies on it for the nightly balance export.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: From today the pager for the event-bus rings the Boreal team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-22] standup/boreal/2025-04-22-2: Observation from team Boreal: after the client rollout, the webhook dispatcher's request volume halved.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The webhooks service is a Boreal service.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-event-bus: Boreal handed the bus to the Dune team today; Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz Nowak.
- [2025-06-06] standup/boreal/2025-06-06: Boreal saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-17] standup/ember/2025-11-17: Team Ember saw that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it. The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-02-06] standup/atlas/2025-02-06: Billing-api calls the ledger service for invoice postings, so treat the ledger service as a hard dependency of billing-api.
- [2025-03-14] standup/atlas/2025-03-14: Dependency map update: the ledger needs the auth gateway (service tokens).
- [2025-04-11] handover/2025-04-11-webhooks: Quick one: webhooks belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to Boreal for running it until now.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Team Boreal has switched to a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-04-10] standup/boreal/2025-04-10: Team Boreal saw that the catalog service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Webhooks deploy window: on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-webhooks: The Ember team handed the webhook dispatcher to team Atlas today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya.
